run_convert_subqs_to_squad: run the script to convert UMT sub-question generations into SQuAD format JSON
build_squad_split_from_subqs: build a SQuAD-format dataset split from UMT sub-question predictions and HotpotQA source data
create_squad_questions_from_subqs: create SQuAD-style question entries from UMT-generated sub-question pairs per HotpotQA example
run_generate_squad_json_split: run the CLI to generate a SQuAD JSON file for a specified dataset split with UMT model parameters
summarize_subq_statistics: summarize sub-question statistics including mean number of sub-questions per example
